title: How is Zeus connected to Luffy from One Piece?
description: An ancient statue, a president, the MythBusters and a cast of voice actors link Zeus to Luffy.
hook: How is Zeus connected to Luffy from One Piece?

links.line: In 2024, Vladimir Putin toured the Hermitage under a giant ancient statue of Jupiter, the Roman Zeus.
In 2015, Putin shook hands with Barack Obama at the United Nations in New York.
In 2010, Obama filmed a MythBusters episode at the White House with Adam Savage.

image.file: File:Jamie Hyneman, Grant Imahara, Adam Savage (7613294308).jpg

links.line: In 2012, Savage shared a Comic-Con stage with fellow MythBuster Grant Imahara.
In 2013, Imahara posed at Phoenix Comicon with actor Chris, son of the original Star Trek's Scotty.

image.file: File:Michele Specht, Vic Mignogna, Chuck Huber, Todd Haberkorn & Chris Doohan (18092409509).jpg

links.line: In 2015, Chris sat on a Phoenix Comicon panel next to voice actor Todd Haberkorn.
In 2011, Haberkorn signed autographs at New York Comic Con with fellow Fairy Tail voice actor Colleen Clinkenbeard.

pair.file: File:Colleen Clinkenbeard & Luci Chrisitan - One Piece QA - 53140731572.jpg

links.line: And Clinkenbeard is the English voice of Luffy, the hero of One Piece.
